datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Afghanistan to collect IPC classification data for different scenarios. The spatial classifications were aggregated into geographic datasets representing acute food insecurity phases, which serve as loss indicators reflecting population vulnerability to food insecurity driven primarily by drought hazards.
